listing.name: [WIP] Derelict Start, Remnant Start, Omega Start & Threat Start
listing.displayName: Derelict Start, Remnant Start, Omega Start & Threat Start
listing.summary: Adds four custom start options for Derelict, Remnant, Omega, and Threat factions with station interaction, automated ships, and hazard immunity.
listing.aiSummary: Adds four custom start options for Derelict, Remnant, Omega, and Threat factions with station interaction, automated ships, and hazard immunity.

description:
Three mods that add Derelict custom start, Remnant custom start, Omega custom start & Threat custom start and put the player under their commission

Allow player interaction with Domain Mothership, Remnant Station, Coronal Hypershunt or Threat fleet with Fabricator Unit as semi-working station

Also allow player to pilot automated ships and have fleetwide immunity to solar corona and similar hazards

By default Derelict, Remnant, Omega & Threat are hostile to most factions but there's a LunaLib settings to turn them peaceful to all but Pirates and Pathers

Inspired from the mod Crabshack's Remnant custom start

Dependencies are

MagicLib

,

Graphicslib

,

LunaLib

&

Nexerelin

Can work with most mods that add Derelict, Remnant or Omega ships

Starts with an Automation XO with

Second-in-Command

Semi-works with Ashes of The Domain

Question of Loyalty

commission

Downloads:

https://github.com/jason0320/Derelict-Start/releases

https://github.com/jason0320/Remnant-Start/releases

https://github.com/jason0320/Omega-Start/releases

https://github.com/jason0320/Threat-Start/releases

aiDescription: Adds four custom start options for Derelict, Remnant, Omega, and Threat factions, placing the player under their commission. Allows interaction with their respective stations and automated ships, grants immunity to solar corona and similar hazards, and includes a Second-in-Command Automation XO at the start.
